name: China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC) 3rd Academy
supervisors: China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC)

evidence.summary: The US Entity List names it as “China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation (CASIC) 3rd Academy”; the list has named it since May 2001, and a 2019 revision split the original entry into the academy and two of its factories. CASIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and describes itself as the main force in building China’s defence weapons and equipment, making China’s full range of missile weapon systems.
It belongs to CASIC, which describes itself as a key state-owned enterprise administered directly by the central government.
